findings.resolution: Before split/join, exact resulting UTF16 length is compared with FileService.maxBytes. Every UTF16 unit contributes at least one UTF8 byte under Node conversion, so necessarily oversized output is rejected without allocation; surviving output is bounded and the original shared writer enforces exact UTF8 bytes. This safely handles surrogate boundaries without a false byte-delta estimate.
